change: Before choosing a berth hour, read the no_moves windows in the rules; never berth inside a no-movement window, berth at its end.
Keep the cranes working in every hour within that hour's pool; the hoot pool (03:00-08:00) is smaller, so give fewer cranes in hoot hours or berth after the hoot shift.
Add up the cranes of every ship alongside in each hour and keep the total within the pool, less any crane outage; cut cranes on the ship with the most slack first.
Respect the movement limit (berthings plus departures per hour): when ships arrive together, stagger their berth hours by one hour.
